target_customer: Data analysts and data teams at companies that write a lot of SQL in existing query editors
problem: SQL is kept in personal notepads, Slack and docs, so two analysts can get different answers to the same question and no team has one source of truth for its queries.
business_model: Freemium B2B SaaS plugin, payment required after a saved-query limit
product_category: SQL repository and collaboration plugin for query editors, later with AI features

founders.name: Noy Twerski
founders.background_notes: YC page lists her as a founder; no background found in sources opened. Aggregators call her CEO.

founders.name: Nadav Gutman
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as a founder; no background found in sources opened.

technical_complexity.rationale: A browser extension and a JetBrains plugin that store and organize SQL snippets, per the YC launch post. Hard parts were embedding into several editors, not core research.

defensibility.rationale: Teams that save their queries inside the tool build up a library that is costly to move, but the launch post names only notepads, Slack, Notion and Google Docs as alternatives, so copying the idea was easy for any editor or data tool vendor.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found showing an incumbent copying or buying Sherloq; the company is still listed as active.

market_need_then: The company says SQL is the number one analysis language yet is managed in scattered personal tools. Its site claims customers such as Taboola and AppsFlyer (company claim, unverified).

branding.domain_note: Company site is sherloqdata.io, not an exact .com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Playful developer tone, for example a pun on SELECTing success on the home page

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launches reported in June 2024 and March 2025, the latter with 304 upvotes per a search summary (not opened).

brand_strength.rationale: Only a Product Hunt presence and a pun-based site tone were found; no press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Sherloq is still active in 2026 as a small team with an SQL repository plugin that has added AI chat on top of saved queries. No shutdown, acquisition or layoff news was found. Funding is not publicly confirmed, so the trajectory after the Winter 2023 batch cannot be judged beyond product launches and a claimed customer list.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights says $500K over 2 rounds (including a Snowflake startup challenge entry dated April 2025), Startup Nation Central lists one Fresh Fund round in January 2022, Startup Index says undisclosed. No company or press confirmation found, so no round is recorded. Aggregators also list Alon Greenfield as CTO co-founder, but the YC page does not, so not listed. Founder education and prior employers not found. No dated competitor sources found near the batch (Kvery.io and SQL Manager appear only on undated auto-generated pages).
